programs.title: Nhk Newsline
programs.desc: . NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programs.title: Core Kyoto
programs.desc: In Kyoto, a box is not a mere box. It protects the dignity and enhances the value of its contents, so it has just as strong a presence. Discover the functionality and aesthetic sense imbued in boxes.

programs.title: Newsroom Tokyo
programs.desc: . NEWSROOM TOKYO dives deeper into the day's news with insight and analysis, from the perspective of Japan and the rest of Asia. We put a spotlight on what you need to know to understand the issues. Yuko Fukushima, Aiko Doden, Takafumi Terui, Shoichiro Beppu, Hideki Nakayama, Takuma Yoshioka, Koichiro Tanaka, Chan-ju Kim, Abhishek Dhulia, Aki Shibuya.

programs.title: Direct Talk
programs.desc: , Episode 242. Kadota Shunji has been working for many years to empower people with disabilities to live independently. His efforts have helped shape policies around the world. He talks about his journey so far. Gene Otani.

programs.title: The Seasons Of Yamato
programs.desc: . A series of poetic videos by Koichi Hozan, a videographer living in Nara, in collaboration with a pianist, Mine Kawakami, for which she plays exclusive pieces, makes you experience each season. Koichi Hozan.

programs.title: One in Every Japanese
programs.desc: 1 in 45 Japanese are suspected of a gambling addiction. We follow a man who made a clean break from gambling, overcoming the crisis of a broken family, and is in the recovery process from addiction.

programs.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE: Bustling Scenes of Old Tokyo
programs.desc: . We visit one of the most famous cherry blossom spots in Edo. Flower viewing parties were for eating, drinking and making merry. It was also an opportunity for young men and women to mingle.

programs.title: Hometown Stories
programs.desc: . A high school allows students with international roots to use their native language while learning Japanese. Teachers hope it will help them build confidence and adapt better to their environment. Soness Stevens, Hiroyuki Hamada, Koji Okubo, Yusuke Ito.

programs.title: Satoyama Kitchen Spring
programs.desc: Hi, it's me, Tama! When I saw a rainbow this morning, I got the feeling there'd be something yummy for me today, and I was right! Grandma Nobuko and Grandpa Makoto are making leaf- wrapped sushi. I can't wait.

programs.title: Japanology Plus
programs.desc: . Japanese confectionery has evolved over centuries, shaped by influences from China and beyond. In Kyoto, artisans honor tradition while advancing the craft with a fresh, modern sensibility. Peter Barakan, Kanako Sachno, Mamoru Abe, Hitoshi Nishiyama, Hirotaka Ohata, Sachiko Miyamoto, Kimiko Fukuda, Chiyo Kawahara.
